## Fall 2026 - Spring 2027 SDSA Webinars

```{r, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE }
library(tidyverse)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)

dt_url <- c(
  "https://us02web.zoom.us/webinar/register/WN_2KG2Y9-LSRaXuSXwX7wMNQ#/registration",
  "https://us02web.zoom.us/webinar/register/WN_5OuKis46ThyozBN4mMBHqQ"
            )

tib = tibble(
  `Date` = c(
    "09/17/2026",
    "10/08/2026"
  ),
    `Time` = c(
    "12pm ET/ 11am CT/ 10am MT/ 9am PT",
    " 3pm ET/  2pm CT/  1pm MT/ 12pm PT"
    ),
  `Speaker` = c(
    "Gillian T. Coughlan, PhD, Massachusetts General Hospital, Harvard Medical School",
    "Hui Zhang, PhD, Northwestern University"
  ),
  `Title` = c(
    "Sex Differences in Alzheimer’s Disease: From Epidemiology to Pathology, Menopause, and Treatment",
    "Unbiased and Robust Analysis of Co-localization in Super-resolution Microscope Images"
  ),
  `Registration/talk links` = c(
     "Zoom Link",
     "Zoom Link"
    )
)

kable(tib[nrow(tib):1,], row.names = FALSE) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "striped",font_size = 15, repeat_header_method = "replace") %>%
  column_spec(1, width = ".5cm") %>%
  column_spec(2, width = "2.2cm") %>%
  column_spec(3, width = "4cm") %>%
  column_spec(4, width = "5cm")%>%
  column_spec(5, width = ".5cm",link = dt_url[nrow(tib):1])
```
